purpose: Blast-radius routing for important semantic and presentation change classes. This is a review checklist, not an executable dependency graph or acceptance mechanism.

changes.name: Canonical schema field change
schemas_contracts: the exact owning versioned schema, identified before selecting an owner
longitudinal-memory, source-set, Promise Progress or normalized-package contract as applicable
identity contract when identity semantics change
parity_oracle_artifacts: affected product parity capture only when visible semantics change
products: every product that selects or serializes the field
changes.workbook_effects: Only through downstream normalized/product bindings; never rename a workbook cell first.
changes.migration_requirement: Classify compatibility, mint a version when required, and provide a deterministic reader/migration before cutover.
changes.notes: There is no universal canonical-schema owner. Name the exact schema first, resolve its owner through the lifecycle/ownership registry, and then apply this blast-radius checklist. The repository does not yet have general schema-migration infrastructure; this registry does not claim otherwise.

changes.name: FiscalCalendar rule change
parity_oracle_artifacts: product parity only where period display/eligibility changes
products: canonical resolutions
ChangeObservation
Promise Progress when affected
changes.workbook_effects: Future consumers may change period labels/order; workbook logic cannot infer the new calendar independently.
changes.migration_requirement: Add a versioned rule and explicit profile/source-set activation; never reinterpret an old period ID.
changes.notes: Ticker branches and month-name inference are prohibited.

changes.name: Source role or format change
goldens: activated source-set/package only after reviewed source addition
products: none automatically; affected products change only through canonical observations
changes.migration_requirement: Add a closed role/version and explicit assertion eligibility; reclassifying an existing document is a reviewed source-set migration.
changes.notes: Use an existing role when authority/eligibility is unchanged.

changes.name: Source-native or sector metric/definition change
parity_oracle_artifacts: visible product parity when labels/values change
products: all selectors explicitly matching the changed identity
changes.workbook_effects: Definition/basis labels and values change only through an approved downstream consumer.
changes.migration_requirement: Mint a new identity; preserve old observations; add explicit supersession/comparability rules where supported.
changes.notes: Use this route for a new source-native/shared or sector metric identity. A ticker profile activates a reusable definition; it does not own the definition. Existing split-owner FCF and net-debt changes use change:free-cash-flow-definition@1 or change:net-debt-definition@1 instead of inventing a sector-pack owner.

changes.name: Free cash flow definition or calculation change
likely_direct_consumers: legacy workbook core and valuation engine
Investment Case and Latest Quarter QA
tests: signals, quarter-note and valuation FCF calculations
standard-template formula contract and normalized validation
ANF capital-return source-adapter lineage and FCF coverage
Latest Quarter QA distinction between CFO less capex and company-adjusted FCF
missing, period, unit and definition incompatibility mutations
goldens: affected legacy workbook/readback evidence when production output changes
affected normalized package and transition workbook outputs
source-native package/product golden only if the changed FCF identity is consumed
parity_oracle_artifacts: read-only workbook oracle and affected product parity only when visible FCF output changes
products: legacy Valuation and Summary
Investment Case and Latest Quarter QA
capital-return projection
normalized valuation inputs and frozen-shell output
changes.workbook_effects: FCF values, yields, margins, per-share measures, valuation scenarios and capital-return coverage may change; presentation code must not choose the definition.
changes.migration_requirement: Name the exact FCF definition and basis, preserve CFO-less-capex versus issuer-adjusted variants, inventory every active/transition consumer, and require an explicit owner migration before consolidation.
changes.notes: FCF has no unified canonical owner across current production and the normalized transition. This route describes blast radius; executable source/formula contracts remain economic authority.

changes.name: Net debt definition or calculation change
likely_direct_consumers: legacy workbook core and valuation engine
Investment Case and Latest Quarter QA
normalized debt/liquidity fields and standard-template formulas
tests: standard-template formula contract and normalized validation
debt-scope/projection instrument, facility and liquidity tests
restricted-cash, lease, revolver, period and missing-input mutations
goldens: affected legacy workbook/readback evidence when production output changes
affected normalized debt/valuation package and transition workbook output
source-native package/product golden only if the changed net-debt identity is consumed
parity_oracle_artifacts: read-only debt/valuation workbook oracle when visible summary output changes
products: legacy Valuation, leverage and Investment Case
Latest Quarter QA
Debt Detail and Leverage/Liquidity transition projections
normalized valuation inputs and frozen-shell output
changes.workbook_effects: Net debt, leverage, enterprise value and related summaries may change. Debt Detail remains source-backed instrument detail and must not be collapsed into the net-debt summary definition.
changes.migration_requirement: Name the exact debt and cash basis, keep gross debt, core debt, revolver, restricted cash, leases and net-cash variants distinct, inventory every active/transition consumer, and require an explicit owner migration before consolidation.
changes.notes: Net debt has no unified canonical owner across current production and the normalized transition. This route describes blast radius; executable debt/formula contracts remain economic authority.

changes.name: Guidance rule or history change
schemas_contracts: Promise Progress block contract when displayed
parity_oracle_artifacts: ANF frozen matrix/bindings if visible guidance output changes
products: Promise Progress annual guidance, open guidance and timeline
changes.workbook_effects: No direct writer rule; future writer consumes product display fields.
changes.migration_requirement: Version semantic rules and retain complete historical versions/relationships.
changes.notes: Never copy a later version backward to populate a quarter bucket.

changes.name: Promise or Status assessment rule change
parity_oracle_artifacts: ANF accepted difference bindings if visible status changes
products: Promise Progress
changes.workbook_effects: Visible status label/color only after product change; writer may not reinterpret.
changes.migration_requirement: Mint/version a closed rule when meaning changes; do not reinterpret historical assessment IDs.
changes.notes: Status palette is presentation metadata, not economic logic.

changes.name: Product visible or shadow field change
schemas_contracts: block field layout and destination contract
goldens: ANF/PBI/generic product and shadow where field is in scope
products: Promise Progress or the owning typed product
changes.workbook_effects: Future writer/template geometry and allowlist only in a separately approved writer pass.
changes.migration_requirement: Version the closed product contract or document a reviewed compatible revision.
changes.notes: Calculation belongs in the product, never Excel.

changes.name: Promise Progress row or block change
parity_oracle_artifacts: frozen legacy capture and source-scope manifests
products: Promise Progress
changes.workbook_effects: Template capacity/layout implications are future writer scope; overflow must fail closed.
changes.migration_requirement: Version row/block identity and review complete parity disposition before any UI cutover.
changes.notes: Do not coerce all four blocks into one generic row model.

changes.name: Workbook destination or binding change
goldens: product shadow only if its declared destination changes
parity_oracle_artifacts: reviewed destination remap and workbook structure evidence
products: no economic product change unless field semantics also change
changes.workbook_effects: Exact target cells, merges, capacities, widths or sheet layout may change.
changes.migration_requirement: Version/review destination remap; never silently move or broaden a writable range.
changes.notes: Binding map owns destinations, not economic meaning.

changes.name: Presentation or style-only workbook change
schemas_contracts: binding map only if geometry moves
products: none economically
changes.workbook_effects: Only the selected visible presentation surface; current output path must be declared first.
changes.migration_requirement: Preserve old shell/version and prove value/formula/source invariance.
changes.notes: Legacy writer and frozen-shell transition paths have different owners.

changes.name: New ticker activation
goldens: later normalized/product/workbook goldens only when separately activated
parity_oracle_artifacts: only if a legacy product oracle is explicitly declared
products: none automatically
changes.workbook_effects: No automatic workbook output; normalized/workbook onboarding is a separate transition/cutover scope.
changes.migration_requirement: Additive company/profile identities. Current profile registration still requires bounded Python code; do not add a shared-runtime ticker branch.
changes.notes: Preferred direction remains shared engine -> sector pack -> ticker profile.

changes.name: New sector-pack concept
products: future products after explicit selection contract
changes.workbook_effects: None until a product/normalized binding is separately approved.
changes.migration_requirement: Add versioned reusable identities; ticker profiles only activate and map company aliases/members.
changes.notes: Do not put reusable sector economics in a ticker profile or workbook.
